description: "A Sermon Preached at Kensington Church, on June the 29th, 1794" by Joseph Phillimore is a religious sermon delivered in the late 18th century. The book encompasses the themes of repentance, divine mercy, and the importance of faith in the face of adversity, likely inspired by the social and political climate of the time, including the significant naval victory referenced in the title.
